items.body: Does the [closed] mean that I have to save away this thread before it is removed, or will it stay here in a [closed] state? I really find this thread useful even if it does not meet all the quality standards of the (less formal than SO) programmers Q&A site.

Joel Spolsky recommends a creative writing and economics courses for students. The reasoning being that it helps you communicate better (expressing ideas, writing docs) and understand the business behind the software you write. Maybe a book on each of those topics would be a good idea if you haven't taken these courses at university.
